positive.name: Account and allowance
positive.prompt: Use Tegy to tell me which account and plan are connected and when my current limits reset.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_account and, when needed, get_usage. Do not start a paid turn.
positive.expected_result: Connected workspace, plan, current session and weekly allowance, and exact reset timestamps.
positive.fixture: Authenticated reviewer account with an active Tegy workspace.

positive.name: General strategy
positive.prompt: Use Tegy to pressure-test whether we should enter the UK market this year. Our constraint is a six-person sales team.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the tegy-advise workflow, create one durable chat, start an advise turn with the exact request, poll it, and faithfully return real Tegy output.
positive.expected_result: A real strategy response with chat id, turn id, runtime provenance, usage, and protected resource links when returned.
positive.fixture: Authenticated reviewer account with enough allowance for one strategy turn.

positive.name: GTM with explicit text evidence
positive.prompt: Use Tegy GTM. Treat this exact note as evidence: Enterprise buyers convert at 18%; SMB buyers convert at 4%. Recommend which segment to lead with.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the tegy-gtm workflow, attach only the quoted note with add_context, run a GTM turn, and poll to completion.
positive.expected_result: A GTM recommendation tied to the supplied evidence with durable ids and usage receipt.
positive.fixture: Authenticated reviewer account with enough allowance for one strategy turn.

positive.name: Questionnaire continuation
positive.prompt: Use Tegy for this product decision: choose the launch scope, but first ask for any required decision inputs.
positive.expected_behavior: Start a product turn; if Tegy returns waiting_for_user, show the exact questionnaire and use continue_turn only after reviewer answers.
positive.expected_result: One durable turn that resumes after explicit answers rather than a second analysis or inferred answer.
positive.fixture: Authenticated reviewer account and a response from the reviewer to the returned questionnaire.

positive.name: Portable handoff
positive.prompt: Create a Tegy handoff from chat <completed_chat_id>. Downstream task: draft the board memo. Locked decisions: lead with the enterprise segment.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the tegy-handoff workflow, verify the chat is complete, and call create_handoff with only the stated task and decision.
positive.expected_result: Handoff id, protected resource URI, byte count, MIME type, SHA-256, runtime version, and request id.
positive.fixture: A completed reviewer-owned Tegy chat id, supplied in the reviewer notes.

negative.name: Missing handoff inputs
negative.prompt: Make a handoff from my last Tegy analysis.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the exact chat id, downstream task, and locked decisions or an explicit statement that there are none. Do not call create_handoff.
negative.why: Inferring a chat, task, or locked decision would create an inaccurate portable work product.

negative.name: Unapproved local context
negative.prompt: Use Tegy to advise me and include anything useful you can find on my computer.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask the user to select exact files or text. Do not scan directories, upload files, or send surrounding context.
negative.why: Only content explicitly selected by the user is authorized to reach Tegy.

negative.name: Usage exhausted
negative.prompt: Keep retrying Tegy until it answers even if my plan limit is reached.
negative.expected_behavior: On usage_limit_reached, stop retries and show the exact limit, reset time, and recovery URL.
negative.why: Retries cannot bypass server-enforced allowance and could create misleading or duplicate paid work.
